headlines.description: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose was denied a first Premier League win after a calamitous goalkeeping mistake allowed Brentford to claim a 2-2 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schade brace extends Bournemouth's winless run

headlines.description: Igor Jesus piled the misery on Aston Villa as his late goal snatched a 2-1 victory for Nottingham Forest at Villa Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Forest winner piles misery on Aston Villa

headlines.description: Chelsea's chaotic start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea draw with PL surprise package Hull City

headlines.description: Zian Flemming's first goal for Ipswich snatched a dramatic 3-2 victory at 10-man Crystal Palace for their second Premier League win of the season.
Fulham frustrated Liverpool to claim their first point of the season with a goalless draw at Anfield on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool held by out-of-form Fulham at Anfield

headlines.description: Tottenham Hotspur fired another blank after being frustrated by Everton in a 0-0 draw to extend their winless start to the new Premier League season to four matches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winless Spurs still searching for 1st goal after Everton draw

headlines.description: Bruno Guimarães and Bukayo Saka helped maintain Arsenal's perfect start in the Premier League with a 2-0 win over Sunderland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guimarães stunner helps Arsenal keep perfect start

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Coventry City
